title: Granada to Cordova visit
text: Thank you Denial for taking us from Granada and to Cordoba to see the mosque and the Jewish quarter. This was amazing, also thanks for dropping us to Seville airport on time for our flight to London. Appreciate your help. Great trip
author: rudrabhay

title: Cordova trip, Angel was Great!
text:
🌟 Just had the most amazing day exploring Cordova with our fantastic guide, Angel! 🌊✨ His passion for the history of this beautiful place truly brought our adventure to life. Our 13-year-old and 11-year-old were all ears, soaking up tales of the past and asking the best questions—thanks to Angel’s patience and endless knowledge! 📚❤️
